case_name: Through the door, then the beach, 17 s, 16:9, text only
title: Through the door

turns.text:
Make a 17-second 16:9 video. There are no reference images.

Mara: a woman in her thirties with short curly red hair, round gold glasses and a mustard-yellow wool coat.
Keep her looking the same from start to end.

What happens, in this order:
1. Mara walks through a walled spring garden under cherry blossom to a blue wooden door in the wall.
2. She opens the door. Through it is a bright summer beach.
3. She steps through the door onto the beach.
4. She walks to the edge of the water, turns to the camera and smiles.

No text on screen, no sound. Give me one finished video file.

tests: Tests one described person who goes from one place to another through a door, and stays the same.

answer_sheet.Person: Mara as described; the same from start to end.
answer_sheet.Action: Garden, door, door opens, beach, edge of the water, turn and smile.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 17-second 16:9 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: Garden, door, door opens, beach, edge of the water: in order, each once
Mara is the same person from start to end
She arrives on the summer beach (no spring garden after the door)
